notes:
Summary: mid-market support SaaS building a conversational agent (live chat & routing). Extremely latency- and cost-sensitive — customer metric: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms for chat intents at sustained 300 req/s. Current infra: on-prem Triton fleet + cloud fallback, monthly spend ~ $18k on tokens/infra. They want ~50% cost reduction while improving tail latency.

Requirements & asks (shorthand / call snippets):
- Workloads: short-chat turn (avg tokens 20–60), reranking for suggestion lists, embeddings for recency search.
- Latency targets: p50 30–40ms; p95 100–120ms at 300 concurrent req/s.
- Throughput target: sustained 300 rps, spikes to 800 rps for flash events.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement wants 40–60% lower per-token operational cost vs current run.
- Model preferences: open-weights chat model compatible with quantization (LLM variant they mentioned internally: "our team prefers Llama2/Alpaca-style + quantized int8/int4 where viable"). Interested in Redwood's recommended model variants and perf profiles.
- Technical asks: guidance on batching policy (max latency budgets), prefix/KV cache usage for repeated session states, quantization tradeoffs for quality vs throughput, and benchmark harness to reproduce p50/p95 numbers.
- Ops/security: VPC private control plane, SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for keys, retention controls and EU data residency for subset of PII.

POC notes:
- 2026-03-10 run (no batching): p50=48ms, p95=140ms. Positive — single-token costs high.
- Next POC step: enable small batching (batch size target 8–16), KV cache with 3-turn prefix reuse, and int8 quant profile; run perf sweep across seq lengths [20,40,80].
- SE asks: provide a perf benchmark harness (JMeter/locust + secretless invocation) and expected metrics schema (p50,p75,p95,p99, cost-per-1k-tokens).

Quotes and friction: "We need predictable tail latency — UX breaks when p95 > 150ms" — Head of Product.
"Procurement needs an apples-to-apples infra cost comparison (on-prem vs Redwood Dedicated) and a clear SLA for fallback to hosted tier."

Open artifacts: pricing deck draft (drive:/decks/lightning-aide-poc-pricing-v2.pdf), security checklist (drive:/security/lightning-aide-security-reqs.docx), Jira tickets INF-2341/INF-2390 for infra config questions.

Sales notes / next actions:
- SE (Maya) to run batched + kv-cache + int8 sweep by 2026-03-18 and attach benchmark CSV.
- Jordan to produce TCO comparison table for procurement (on-prem vs dedicated vs hosted) by 2026-03-20.
- Need network egress sign-off; procurement estimated 2–3 weeks.
